Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding capital rate add-on payments for boarding homes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to capital rate addon payments for boarding homes;adding a new section to chapter 74.39A RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The purpose of this section is to recognize the significantfinancial commitment made by providers to construct new or remodeledhousing for the state's elderly who receive medicaid contractedassisted living services in boarding homes. Therefore, boarding homeproviders who had submitted new construction plans, or plans to remodelan existing boarding home to the department of health, constructionreview, before June 30, 2002, shall, on the effective date of this act,receive a capital rate addon as long as: (1) The boarding home provider was receiving a capital rate addonpayment before June 30, 2002; and (2) The boarding home was built or remodeled to provide thefollowing: (a) Private apartmentlike units; p. 1 SB 5813 (b) A kitchen area equipped with a refrigerator, a microwave ovenor stovetop, and a counter or table for food preparation. In a newfacility, a kitchen area must also be equipped with a sink and counterarea, and storage space for utensils and supplies; (c) A lockable entry door; (d) A separate private bathroom, including a sink, toilet, andshower or bathtub. In a new facility, a minimum of fifty percent ofthe bathrooms shall be wheelchair accessible and have a rollin shower; (e) In a remodeled facility, an individual unit shall have aminimum of one hundred eighty square feet including counters, closets,and builtins, excluding the bathroom. In a new facility, anindividual unit shall have a minimum of two hundred twenty square feetincluding counters, closets, and builtins, excluding the bathroom; (f) A living area shall be wired for telephone service and, wheregeographically possible, wired for television service; (g) In a new facility, the contractor shall provide a privateaccessible mailbox; and (h) A homelike smokefree common area or areas with sufficientspace for socialization designed to meet resident needs. The capital rate addon payment made under this section shall be atleast equal to the rate amount received before implementation of thecapital rate addon reduction in funding resulting from chapter 371,Laws of 2002.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
